column3: Wide cinematic shot of a stock exchange listing ceremony stage in Hong Kong. ALEX (the first man in the reference sheet, navy suit) stands at centre beside a large ceremonial gong with five executives in dark suits, everyone applauding and smiling, fine golden confetti drifting down, press camera flashes from out-of-focus silhouettes in the foreground. Behind them a huge LED wall glowing deep red and warm gold with soft abstract blurred bokeh, no readable characters or numbers. Celebratory yet elegant and restrained.

Night. Medium close shot inside the rear seat of a dark luxury sedan. ALEX (first man in the reference sheet), jacket open, sits alone, his face softly lit by the cool glow of the smartphone he holds low in both hands, contemplative and quiet. Through the rain-flecked side window the Hong Kong skyline passes as soft amber and blue bokeh streaks. Introspective, cinematic, low key.

Warm candid family photograph on a university graduation lawn in golden afternoon light: SOPHIE (third woman in the reference sheet) in a black graduation gown and cap, beaming, between her parents ALEX (first man) and EMMA (second woman), arms around each other. Natural, joyful, shallow depth of field, like a real photograph taken by a professional.

Daytime, a modern corporate banking boardroom high above Victoria Harbour, floor-to-ceiling windows with soft daylight. ALEX (first man in the reference sheet) sits at a long walnut table opposite a corporate banking team of three people in dark suits; the corporate relationship director, a grey-haired Chinese man in his late fifties, leans forward with an open hand, asking a thoughtful question. Documents and a tablet on the table. Polished, calm, professional.

A discreet private banking client lounge: walnut panelling, cream leather armchairs, a single red orchid, warm window light. MAYA (fourth woman in the reference sheet) shakes hands warmly with ALEX (first man) at the entrance; behind MAYA stand her two specialists, a credit specialist (South Asian man in his forties, navy suit) and a trust planner (Chinese woman in her fifties with a short grey bob, charcoal suit). Welcoming, refined, quiet luxury.

High-angle over-the-shoulder shot of a dark smoked-glass interactive meeting table in a private bank. MAYA (fourth woman) and ALEX (first man) sit at the edges, only their forearms, hands and partial shoulders visible, leaning in. The table surface is dark, faintly glowing and empty, leaving a large clean area in the centre of the frame. Warm moody lighting, shallow depth of field.

Medium wide shot of a private bank meeting room with a large wall display that shows only a soft dark blue gradient. ALEX, EMMA and SOPHIE (first three people in the reference sheet) sit together on one side of a round walnut table; MAYA (fourth woman) sits across from them, gesturing openly toward the screen. Warm daylight, inclusive, attentive atmosphere.

Medium close shot: EMMA (second woman in the reference sheet) and MAYA (fourth woman) sit side by side on a cream sofa looking at a tablet together; EMMA is focused, confident, with a slight smile, MAYA explains calmly. Soft window light, shallow depth of field, elegant interior.

SOPHIE (third woman in the reference sheet) and MARCUS (fifth man, glasses, charcoal three-piece suit) sit at a modern light-oak study table with a laptop and a notebook; MARCUS points at the laptop screen (screen content not readable), SOPHIE leans in, engaged and curious, pen in hand. Bright contemporary space with plants and natural light.

Evening in a stylish city apartment. SOPHIE (third woman in the reference sheet), in a soft cream knit sweater, stands by a tall window holding her smartphone and looking at it with a thoughtful, slightly concerned expression. Dusk city lights and heavy clouds outside, faint raindrops on the glass. Cool blue exterior, warm lamp interior.

DAVID (sixth man in the reference sheet) at a client service desk on a modern private bank operations floor, wearing a slim headset, looking attentively at two monitors whose screens glow but are not readable, alert and professional. Evening office lighting, colleagues softly blurred in the background.

MARCUS (fifth man in the reference sheet, glasses, charcoal three-piece suit, burgundy tie) sits at his desk in a glass-walled office facing the camera directly as if on a video call, composed and reassuring, one hand slightly raised mid-explanation. Soft key light, bookshelves and city view softly blurred behind.

Night, a hospital intensive care corridor abroad, cool clinical light, long perspective. EMMA (second woman in the reference sheet), wearing a dark camel coat over her blouse, stands near a window holding a phone to her ear, anxious but composed, the other hand at her temple. Blurred medical staff far down the corridor. Restrained, cinematic, desaturated teal tones.

Night, MAYA (fourth woman in the reference sheet) at her desk in a dim private bank office, city lights behind the window, a phone held to her ear, focused and calm, the other hand on a laptop keyboard. Warm desk lamp against cool window light.

Night, a white medical air-ambulance jet on an airport apron under floodlights, a stretcher being carefully loaded by medical crew in the middle distance, light rain reflections on the tarmac. Calm, competent, cinematic. No logos, no lettering on the aircraft.

Wide shot of a modern private bank operations and relationship centre in the evening: a large curved dark video wall showing only a soft abstract deep-blue glow without any text, MAYA (fourth woman) and MARCUS (fifth man) standing in front of it in discussion, an operations lead (Chinese woman in her forties, black blazer) at a console in the foreground. Sophisticated, quiet, cinematic.

A sunlit private banking meeting room with tall windows overlooking the harbour. ALEX (healthy, smiling), EMMA, SOPHIE, MAYA, MARCUS and DAVID (all six people from the reference sheet) stand in a loose circle raising glasses of champagne, sharing genuine warm laughter. Golden morning light, uplifting, elegant, medium wide shot.

Close-up of a firm, sincere handshake between ALEX (first man, navy suit sleeve) and the corporate relationship director (grey suit sleeve) after an IPO ceremony, golden confetti blurred in the background, shallow depth of field, warm light.
Aerial wide shot of Victoria Harbour, Hong Kong at blue hour just before dawn, calm water, skyline lights reflecting, light mist, a few city lights still on. Serene, cinematic, premium.

Minimal architectural abstract for a premium brand film background: a dark charcoal honed stone wall with a single thin vertical slit of warm light, subtle natural texture, large areas of negative space, very low key.

Medium close-up of ALEX (first man in the reference sheet, navy suit, light blue open-collar shirt) seated at a walnut boardroom table high above Victoria Harbour, daylight from floor-to-ceiling windows behind him softly out of focus, he speaks earnestly to someone off-camera left, hands loosely together, a thoughtful, slightly concerned expression. 85mm lens, shallow depth of field.

Medium close-up of SOPHIE (third woman in the reference sheet, light grey blazer, white top, long straight black hair) at a light-oak study table in a bright modern space, laptop edge in the foreground, she looks up from the screen with a quiet, confident, genuine smile of understanding, natural window light, plants softly blurred behind. 85mm lens, shallow depth of field.

Medium close-up of SOPHIE (third woman in the reference sheet, light grey blazer, white top) sitting at a light-oak table, chin resting lightly on her hand, looking at a notebook with a serious, curious, thoughtful expression, pen in her other hand, soft natural light, bright modern room softly blurred. 85mm lens, shallow depth of field.

Cinematic film still, 16:9. Daytime in a discreet private banking floor: a quiet corridor just outside a client lounge, walnut-panelled walls, warm window light, the open lounge doorway softly out of focus behind her with cream armchairs and a single red orchid. MAYA, the woman from the reference image (same face, same hair pinned back, navy suit, ivory silk blouse, fine gold necklace), stands alone in medium shot, three-quarter angle facing camera-left, holding a slim tablet in both hands at chest height and reading it attentively, calm and prepared, a slight focused expression, a moment before walking in to meet a client. The tablet screen faces away from camera and is not visible. Only one person in the frame. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, restrained premium colour grade matching the lounge reference, no text, no logos.

Cinematic film still, 16:9. Night, the same dark private bank office as the environment reference: brass desk lamp, red flowers, city skyline lights through the window. MAYA, the woman from the person reference (same face, hair pinned back, navy suit, ivory blouse), seated at her desk in a medium close-up from a slightly different angle than the environment reference, three-quarter view facing camera-right, wearing a small discreet earpiece, speaking calmly and reassuringly while reading her laptop screen, one hand resting on the trackpad, the cool glow of the screen on her face mixed with warm lamp light. The laptop screen faces away and is not visible. Only one person in the frame. 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, composed, steady, quietly in control. No text, no logos.

Cinematic film still, 16:9. A discreet private banking client lounge in warm afternoon light, walnut panelling, cream leather armchairs, a single red orchid softly out of focus, matching the environment reference. ALEX, the man from the person reference (same face and short dark hair, navy suit, light blue open-collar shirt), sits at a small walnut table in a medium close-up, three-quarter view facing camera-left, signing a printed two-page document with a black fountain pen, concentrating, calm and deliberate. At the right edge of the frame only the forearm and hand of a woman in a navy suit sleeve rests near the page, a finger indicating a line, her face not in frame. The document text is small and not readable. Only one face in the frame. 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, restrained premium colour grade. No readable text, no logos.

Cinematic film still, 16:9. Mid-afternoon in the same private bank office as the environment reference (dark walnut panelling, brass desk lamp, red flowers, tall window with the Hong Kong skyline), now in soft overcast daylight. MAYA, the woman from the person reference (same face, hair pinned back, navy suit, ivory silk blouse, fine gold necklace), sits at her desk facing the camera directly as if on a video call, composed and reassuring, one hand slightly raised mid-explanation, a slim laptop open in front of her with its screen facing away from camera. Medium shot, eye level, centred. Only one person in the frame. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, restrained premium colour grade. No text, no logos.

Cinematic film still, 16:9. Mid-afternoon in the same private bank office as the environment reference (dark walnut panelling, brass desk lamp, red flowers, tall window with the Hong Kong skyline), soft overcast daylight. MAYA, the woman from the person reference (same face, hair pinned back, navy suit, ivory silk blouse), sits at her desk in a three-quarter view facing camera-right, leaning slightly toward a large desktop monitor whose screen faces away from camera and is not visible, reading an incoming alert with a focused, calm expression; her right hand is lifting the handset of a desk phone. Medium shot. Only one person in the frame. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, restrained premium colour grade. No text, no logos.

Cinematic film still, 16:9. Recreate the reference image exactly: the same modern private bank operations and relationship centre in the evening, the same large curved dark video wall glowing soft deep blue with no text, the same furniture, red flowers and lighting, the same camera angle. Keep the woman in the navy suit standing in front of the video wall (same face, hair pinned back, ivory blouse) gesturing toward the wall, and keep the operations lead seated at the console in the foreground (Chinese woman in her forties, black blazer, same face). Remove the man with glasses and the charcoal three-piece suit completely; where he stood there is only the video wall. Exactly two people in the frame. Sophisticated, quiet, cinematic. No text, no logos.

Cinematic film still, 16:9. Recreate the first reference image: the same sunlit private banking meeting room with tall windows overlooking the harbour, golden morning light, the same group raising glasses of champagne in a loose circle with genuine warm laughter. Keep these five people exactly as in the first reference, same faces, hair and clothes: the man in the navy suit on the far left, the woman in the camel suit, the young woman in the light grey suit, the woman in the navy suit, and the young man in the grey suit on the right. Remove the man with glasses and the charcoal three-piece suit with burgundy tie; he must not appear. In his place add the two specialists from the second reference image, same faces and clothes: the South Asian man in his forties in a navy suit, and the Chinese woman in her fifties with a short grey bob in a charcoal suit, both smiling and raising glasses. Exactly seven people. Medium wide shot, uplifting, elegant. No text, no logos.

Cinematic film still, 16:9. Early evening client reception hosted by HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking after a Hong Kong IPO, in an elegant private function room with floor-to-ceiling windows and the Victoria Harbour skyline at dusk, warm golden practical lights, a few softly out-of-focus guests in business attire holding drinks far in the background. In the foreground, two people talk one-to-one, standing near the window: ALEX, the man from the first reference (same face, same short black hair, navy suit, light blue open-collar shirt), on the LEFT, holding a glass of sparkling water, listening and engaged; and MAYA, the woman from the second reference (same face, hair pinned back, navy suit, ivory silk blouse), on the RIGHT, facing him at three-quarter view, speaking warmly and attentively with a relaxed open-hand gesture, clearly the one who started the conversation. Medium two-shot from waist up, both faces clearly visible, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, restrained premium colour grade. Exactly two people in focus. No text, no logos, no signage.
